units.text: In Health, this chapter favours hard exercise over sitting still, and the days you work off the extra force are your calmest.

Your Home Chapter carries {el}, the energy of Mind, one that works against your chart. Since your mid-thirties, home has offered so much comfort and counsel that your own decisions wait. You make one small decision a day alone, and your judgement comes back with use.
In Career, this chapter favours one role done well over several begun, and the depth you build earns more than reach.
This chapter puts a frame around your strength, one your chart welcomes. You do your best work inside clear roles and firm deadlines.

Your Home Chapter carries {el}, the energy of Expression, and your chart cannot use all of it. Since your mid-thirties, appetite and opinion have filled the house, and your restlessness has set its pace. An hour of quiet each evening settles it, and you are learning to let a partner have the last word.

Your Home Chapter carries {el}, the energy of Action, and your chart is glad of it. From your mid-thirties a partner and a household widen your reach, with more coming in and more to look after. You take on the house as a shared project, and the effort shows in every corner of it.
In Career, this chapter favours good advice over a bigger title, and you do your best work among people whose judgement you trust.
This chapter loosens your tongue and your appetite more than your chart can use. Your words land harder the fewer you use, and that keeps your standing.
These years brought {el} into your stride and your say, a strength your chart had wanted. You walked further and took on what others had always done for you.
These years brought {el} to the family table as a sharp tongue, with opinions ready for every topic. You kept your welcome by letting the people after you finish their sentences.
These years brought {el} in a rush, with a quick tongue that got you into trouble in class. You learned to ask before you argued, and the trouble grew rarer.
In Career, this chapter favours a voice in the meeting over a place in the queue, and the footing you find comes from people who work at your level.

Your Late Chapter carries {el}, the energy of Order, and your chart has been glad to have it. Since your late forties you have held a settled place, the one whose word decides and whose standards the people after you take up. You give that authority daily attention, and you carry it lightly.

Your Home Chapter carries {el}, your own energy, in a chart that is already crowded with it. Since your mid-thirties, the household has felt like a contest of wills, and you rarely give way first. Time apart for your own interests cools it down, and you are learning that yielding at home costs you little.
In Love, this chapter favours laughing with a partner over keeping things serious, and the affection you show comes openly and easily.
This chapter rewards reaching. You gain most from the offers you take up and put to use straight away.

Your Home Chapter carries {el}, the energy of Action, and your chart takes it in gladly. Since your mid-thirties the household has become a place of making things work, with a partner beside you and more to manage each year. You see each plan through, and the home grows solid around you.

Your Home Chapter carried {el}, the energy of Order, and your chart welcomed its firm hand. From your mid-thirties to your late forties the household ran on agreements you and a partner kept, and every promise added to your name. You came away with a home in good order and a reputation for doing what you said.
These years brought {el} and a louder voice at school, in class and among friends. Someone in your first home enjoyed your stories, and you kept telling them.
At home, this chapter favours cooking and making things together over keeping the place tidy, and the things you make fill the house.
These years brought {el} through classmates who wanted the same place and the same turn. You learned to stand up for your share, and you never quite stopped.
Keeping your word to a partner|leaving things vague
Under it runs {g}, drawing the {e} away, and the share you carry lightens as it drains.
Under it ran {g}, which slowly drew the {e} away, and year by year you carried less of it.
Under it runs {g}, which keeps feeding the {e}, and whatever you set down comes back.
Under it ran {g}, which kept feeding the {e}, but you learned to set it down as fast as it returned.
Under it runs {g}, checking the {e} as it goes, and what you meet from it loses some of its grip.
Under it ran {g}, kept down by the {e} at the price of its force, and you met less of it.
Under it ran {g} of the same kind, one pull from top to bottom, but you learned its shape by heart.
